name: assessing L-Space demand
from: Demand L-Space took up from the work board (a request it promised or a report it adopted), held unassessed in its own root.
to: The demand is either L-Space's own work, admitted under the taken subject as items its own offices bear duties for, with any part it does not do posted back on the board; or it is given back (released or declined) with the reason it is not L-Space's work.
cost: Bounded assessment attention of L-Space's lead on the host's execution capacity; no financial, credential or external commitment.
otherwise: Demand about the cross-media L-Space, its canonical Science-owned site, token/claim meaning or typed bit-topology remains a named open obligation of the competent office until independently received. Requests for Digital Garden, VaultMaze, generic publication or unrelated Lenticule Science work are not L-Space's own demands merely because they share marks or a domain.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the assessment's evidence and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own assessment.
